newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: LG Info sees 820 bln won 1996 sales.
newsitem.headline: LG Info sees 820 bln won 1996 sales.

text.p: South Korea's LG Information and Communications Ltd, a unit of LG Group, said on Friday it saw its sales rising to 820 billion won this year from 513 billion in 1995.
An LG Information statement said it expected turnover of 1.1 trillion won in 1997 and 5.5 trillion won in 2005.

Based on LG Information's technology of code division multiple access (CDMA), the company plans to strengthen its mobile phone and personal communications system equipment businesses, the statement said.
The company also plans to increase exports of personal computers, mobile communication and transmission equipments.

LG will also try to expand its markets in industrialised countries, such as the United States and Europe. LG's exports currently focus on developing nations such as Vietnam, China, Romania and Russia, it said.
